lines.text: In thirty days, his mom has set him up on his first ever blind date.
Right now, his socks can stand up on their own.
His haircut is older than his phone.
His kitchen is forty-seven takeout boxes.
And the last time he talked to a woman, it was to order a bubble tea. Large. No ice.
Leo can't fix all of this alone. So you're going to help.
Every day, you pick one thing he fixes. And once it's fixed, it stays fixed.
Day one. Haircut, or the takeout boxes?
Comment one word. The winner gets fixed tomorrow.
Thirty days. One date. Let's go.
